employment.working_hours: 40 hours per week, with timing agreed with Didigam Nithin (CEO)
employment.compensation: INR 16,00,000 per annum (16 LPA), equivalent to approximately INR 1,33,333 per month before applicable deductions
responsibilities: Lead the design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance of reliable software products and services.
Own technical decisions, code quality, architecture documentation, and delivery of assigned engineering work.
Collaborate with product, design, data, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into maintainable solutions.
Review code, mentor team members, improve engineering practices, and communicate risks and progress clearly.
Protect company, client, and user information and follow all security, privacy, and responsible-AI requirements.
employment.equipment_and_access: Nhancio may provide accounts, repositories, datasets, or equipment needed for approved work. All access remains company property and must be returned or disabled when requested or when employment ends.
employment.expenses: Only expenses approved in writing before they are incurred will be eligible for reimbursement against valid receipts.

terms.leave_policy: You are eligible for leave in accordance with Nhancio's leave policy and applicable law. Planned leave must be requested in advance and approved by your reporting manager; emergencies should be communicated as soon as reasonably possible. Leave balances, holidays, and any carry-forward rules will be administered under the policy in force from time to time.
terms.notice_period: the notice period stated in your employment terms and applicable law
terms.background_verification: This offer is subject to the accuracy of the information and documents provided by you and any reasonable identity, education, employment, or background checks requested by Nhancio.
